Validated web-codecs profile · 2026-11-27 · linux x64 · v24.16.0
Resize uses engine defaults: PureJsImage and Sharp use Lanczos 3; Jimp and ImageScript use bilinear. Timings include encoding and are not matched quality across kernels or lossy encoders.

Source: 2026-11-27T13-07-40-398Z-purejsimage-purejsimage-wasm-jimp-sharp-sharp-single-thread-image-js-imagescript-jsquash-web-codecs.json · Unsupported rows are explicit; only validated outputs contribute performance bars.
